I realize that the default for border-style is none, and when using the shorthand for border, it sets the width, style, and color. Only specifying border-width won't set the style, leading to an invisible border. In Tailwind, preflight typically sets border-style to solid for all elements. **Fixing global CSS issues**

The user is reporting no borders, which could mean border-color is transparent or border-style is actually none.
